title: Winter recreation and warmth

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Pair outdoor activity with warm details so the season is expressed through experience rather than snow alone.
strategic_value: Skiing, bathing and steaming cups can give Helsinki winter imagery several emotional registers.
demonstration: A skier, winding boardwalk, bundled standing figure, seated bather, fire and steaming cups are distributed on gray beneath sun and clouds.
practical_value: Choose contrasting cold-weather activities and warm details to suit the desired tone.

content_islands.name: Sky and recreation
content_islands.spec: Place sun, clouds, skier and boardwalk in the upper half.

content_islands.name: Warmth and rest
content_islands.spec: Arrange the seated bather, cups and fire below the standing figure.
